decisions: Documentation/templates and read-only audit only; no new runtime importer, operators or quantization.
Unknown requirements remain null/unassessed/pending, not false, none-needed or approved.
Requirements are conditioned on actual model stages and target; no fixed model, architecture or W4A8 assumption.
Missing implementation or evidence is pending_validation; query alone is not model admission.
Work remains local with no Git commit or push.
limitations: No real candidate inventory, model accuracy or target resource/performance conclusion.
S5 historical 174-test/sanitizer evidence verified by hashes, not rerun as new S6 results.
Current capability limits apply to existing PC runtime only.
Memory formulas measure specified payload/reservations; not full process RSS or a hardware memory map.
Signed-zero acceptance does not imply quantized padding support.
Independent review was not repeated after documentation corrections.
